description: Capabilities for the main editor window: the core event/invoke surface, and nothing else. The dialog and fs PLUGINS are deliberately not granted — the renderer no longer calls either. File dialogs are this application's own commands (src/commands/file.rs) so that the backend learns which file the user chose and can hold every read and write to it (src/fsgrant.rs); a renderer that could open its own dialog would leave the backend unable to tell a chosen path from an invented one. Nothing here can start a process, open a socket, reach the filesystem plugin, or relaunch the app.
